name: What should I ask or check if I had a bad experience with a previous roofer and I’m nervous about hiring again?

mainEntity.name: What should I ask or check if I had a bad experience with a previous roofer and I’m nervous about hiring again?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Focus on **transparency, documentation, and communication** when vetting your next roofer. Use your past experience to create a clear checklist of what went wrong and address each item upfront.

A good contractor will be comfortable with detailed questions and may even help you inspect previous work. If someone is defensive or vague, move on.

Key factors:
- Detailed written scope, including what is and isn’t included
- Clear communication plan: daily updates, point of contact, change-orders
- References from recent customers with similar projects
- Willingness to walk you through photos and explain technical choices

Explain your previous bad experience and ask how they handle those issues differently. Choose a roofer who takes the time to answer thoroughly and puts commitments in writing; that alone will reduce the chance of repeat problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use your prior bad experience as a checklist: insist on a detailed written scope, clear communication plan, recent references, and thorough photo documentation of the work. If a roofer resists questions or written commitments, treat that as a sign to keep looking.
